scoringGuidance: Score the stated target for one- and two-step questions from a graph: accuracy, the quality of the model or reasoning, and the revision. Accept any valid approach that meets the criteria. Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
masteryRule: One correct response cannot establish mastery of one- and two-step questions from a graph. Mastery requires accurate independent evidence plus explanation on at least two separate occasions, separated by time or by representation. Guided success is recorded as supported and is not weighted as independent evidence.
